title: Patella fracture & dislocation（髌骨骨折与脱位）

properties.disease overview: Patellar fractures (direct blow or indirect quadriceps contraction) and patellar dislocation (usually lateral, often recurrent) affecting the extensor mechanism and patellofemoral joint.
properties.mechanism: Direct impact → comminuted patella fracture; indirect sudden quadriceps contraction → transverse/avulsion patterns; dislocation often occurs laterally with twisting injury and predisposition to instability.
